explanation: This forecast uses current MLS standings, each team’s season-long scoring and defending record, the remaining schedule, and an assumed home-field advantage. It simulates every remaining match involving a Western Conference team 50,000 times, then counts how often Austin finishes in each position. Teams share the same result when they play each other. The percentages are estimates from a simple statistical model—not guarantees or calibrated betting odds.
fixes: Replaced 29 independent placeholder team appearances with the complete 80-match Western run-in.
Corrected Vancouver's GP and restored its tenth remaining fixture.
Used seed 20260914 and published executable code and input data for reproducibility.
Removed subjective club strength overrides; baseline derives attack/defense rates from season goals.
Replaced fixed 25% draws with draws arising from simulated scorelines.
Replaced strength-based tiebreaking with points, wins, GD, GF in official priority order; explicitly bounded remaining ties.
Placed playoff cutoff below 9th and labeled top-9 probability correctly.
Headline gives median points and median Western position; identifies them as separate marginal medians.
Removed unsupported form and home-game claims; computes remaining home counts directly from fixtures.
Shows model sensitivity and identifies selected parameter choices as uncalibrated.
Preserved model.js, data.json, report.json and update instructions as deployable public source.
Corrected reach-42/45 versus qualifying probability distinction.
v2.2: added a Dixon-Coles low-score correction calibrated to the season draw rate; independent Poissons produced ~85 draws where the 2026 season had 95 in 372 matches.

v2.3: added every club’s finishing-position heatmap, GD/GF and remaining expected points in the standings, a weekly rooting guide (conditional odds for every fixture in the first week of remaining play), the points curve, and deterministic magic/tragic numbers. fixed results now accept any fixture from the home side’s view.
limitations: Not backtested or calibrated. Not a trained AI predictor, bookmaker model, or xG model.
Eight pseudo-games of league-average scoring shrink extreme rates; this and the log home effect 0.13 are assumed parameters.

Poisson goal counts are corrected only for the low-score draw deficit (Dixon-Coles rho, refitted each ingest); they still omit within-match correlation beyond that, lineups, injuries, travel, schedule-adjusted historical strength, and roster changes.
Strengths stay fixed during simulations. East-vs-East fixtures cannot alter them.
After ties on points, wins, GD and GF, the model uses a seeded random order instead of historical head-to-head, disciplinary and venue tiebreakers. Austin boundary bounds are published.
Sensitivity runs change one assumption at a time and are not confidence intervals.
Data is an explicitly dated snapshot, not a live feed.
Scheduled site updates are configured separately; unattended publishing has not yet been demonstrated.
